text:
Nishant: Heads-up — during the 11:00 UTC batch ramp we saw p95 east-west latency jump from ~6ms to ~120ms for ~20-40s windows on the gpu-serving pool. A bunch of in-flight KV cache hits timed out and a few requests fell back to smaller models. Anyone else seeing an e2w microburst?
Kai: yep telemetry shows a tight spike at 11:02. heatmap lines up with batch-window start and autoscaler activity. looks like RDMA queue retries increased.
Devon: I grabbed a tcpdump on one host, saw a burst of retransmits and some ICMP fragmentation-needed messages — suspect MTU mismatch on a path during the burst. snippet:
```
14:02:18.123456 IP 10.10.3.7 > 10.10.4.12: frag needed, mtu 1500
14:02:18.123789 TCP 10.10.3.7.12345 > 10.10.4.12.443: Retransmission
```
Miguel: infra-telemetry also shows a transient drop in `ib0` packets for a subset of nodes. `ibstat` reported port errors on gpu-prod-7 around the same time.
Ops-bot: [alert] RDMA queue timeout on gpu-prod-7 detected at 11:02:19. Autoscaler: scale-up 4->6 pods.
Kai: also saw ECMP path rehashing around that time (control-plane config rollout 11:01). Could be coincidence.
Nishant: someone run quick ethtool and mtu checks on affected hosts? if one host flips to 1500 while rest at 9000 we get fragmentation.
Devon: ran checks on gpu-prod-7/gpu-prod-8:
```
# ethtool -k eth0
rx-checksumming: on
large-receive-offload: on
# ip link show eth0
eth0 mtu 9000 qlen 1000
# ip route get 10.10.4.12
via 10.10.2.1 dev eth0 src 10.10.3.7 mtu 9000
```
But one ToR showed MTU 1500 in its config dump; suspect sporadic control-plane push.
Miguel: log from ToR: `config-sync: apply template v2 -> v1 rollback due to script failure` at 11:01:58.
Kai: temporary mitigation: force TCP fallback for affected workloads or pin batch traffic to same rack. quick fix: `sysctl net.core.default_qdisc=fq` + disable GRO/GSO for batch pods.
Ops-bot: runbook step executed: disable GRO/GSO on host gpu-prod-7 at 11:06.
Devon: after disabling GRO/GSO the next batch ramp had p95 ~9ms, minor spikes only. so GRO/GSO + MTU mismatch likely amplified the microburst.
Nishant: root cause hypothesis: partial ToR template rollback changed MTU to 1500 -> fragmentation + RDMA retries -> autoscaler churn amplifies traffic -> short e2w latency microburst. Plan:
- Miguel: audit template rollout tooling and block config-sync during peak batch windows
- Devon: revert buggy template and validate all ToRs are MTU=9000
- Kai: add dataplane guard to detect MTU divergence and fail deployments
- Docs: add runbook section and postmortem + cost calc
Miguel: scheduling maintenance 02:00 UTC to reapply templates with validation. I'll email infra-sig.
Kai: adding Prom rule for MTU mismatch detection and an auto-suppress for noise.
Devon: pushed draft runbook for fragmentation/rdma checks + GRO/GSO toggle.
Ops-bot: [ticket created] INF-2243 "ToR MTU divergence causing e2w latency microbursts" assigned to infra-sig, priority P2.
Nishant: thanks all — leaving thread open until templates validated. will post postmortem after verification.
